candidates.quote: The developer has agreed to set aside 12 of the 120 homes as affordable homes.
These homes would serve households at or below 60 percent of area median income.
Staff understands that the income limits would last for 30 years.
The request is for a 50 percent reduction in property taxes on the new building for 20 years.
candidates.value: 50 percent reduction in property taxes for 20 years

candidates.quote: Staff recommends that the Council support the request for a 20-year property tax reduction.
